products.title: LG 27BA45U-B 27" 4K HDR Monitor
products.description: The LG 27BA45U-B is a 27-inch flat panel IPS monitor featuring a 4K UHD resolution (3840 x 2160). Designed for color accuracy with a 90% DCI-P3 (CIE1976) color gamut and HDR10 support, it is suitable for professional and detailed visual work. The monitor offers a 5 ms (GTG) response time and versatile connectivity with one DisplayPort and two HDMI ports. It features a flexible stand with tilt, height, swivel, and pivot adjustments, and is VESA compatible (100 x 100mm). Additional specialized features include Flicker safe, Reader Mode, Color Weakness Mode, Super Resolution+, Black Stabilizer, Dynamic Action Sync, and Smart Energy Saving.

products.title: LG 27HS713C-B 27" Class Webcam 4K UHD LED Monitor
